context: A teen comes down with a cold; mother checks on her
purpose: Teach: 確認する/検診/寒い/笑顔/寝室/朝食/翌朝/起き上がる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくら、もう朝なのに寝室から出てこないけど、大丈夫？
lines.en: Sakura, it's already morning and you haven't come out of your bedroom—are you okay?
lines.style: Worried maternal tone, soft and gentle voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ママ…体が重くて、ベッドから起き上がることができないの。
lines.en: Mom... my body feels heavy, I can't get up from bed.
lines.style: Weak raspy voice, slightly congested sickly teen tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 熱を確認するから、ちょっと触らせて。うわ、けっこうあるね。
lines.en: Let me check your temperature, let me touch you a sec. Wow, it's pretty high.
lines.style: Concerned but calm, practical maternal hands-on voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の夜、寒いのに薄着で帰ってきちゃったから…ごめんなさい。
lines.en: Last night I came home in thin clothes even though it was cold... sorry.
lines.style: Apologetic and sniffling, weak guilty teenage voice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 謝らなくていいのよ。朝食はおかゆを作るから、寝室で待ってて。
lines.en: You don't need to apologize. I'll make rice porridge for breakfast, so wait in your bedroom.
lines.style: Reassuring warm tone, take-charge maternal voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、ママ…ごめん、今日は笑顔も出ないかも。
lines.en: Thanks, Mom... sorry, I might not even be able to smile today.
lines.style: Faint grateful voice, exhausted but affectionate tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翌朝に熱が下がっても、念のため検診を受けに行こうね。
lines.en: Even if your fever goes down by the next morning, let's go get a check-up just in case.
lines.style: Firm caring tone, motherly decision-making voice
